research_scope: Game-wide exact weapon roll corrections and PvE/PvP ability trigger exceptions

roll_corrections.official_summary: Europa and Moon Rocket Launchers could unintentionally drop Lead from Gold; Bungie changed existing affected instances to Impromptu Ammunition.
roll_corrections.code_integration: Use audit_roll_observations --corrections only after independent exact item/plug/socket hashes and effective timestamp are verified; never fabricate a correction row.

roll_corrections.official_summary: Certain raid Adept weapon perk pools were out of sync with base versions; Bungie updated Adepts including existing inventory instances.

ability_trigger_leads.official_summary: Bungie fixed Grenade Kickstart activating when using a free Grapple from a Grapple Tangle or the Grappler modifier.
ability_trigger_leads.pve_implication: Do not count Grenade Kickstart refund for free Grapple events in ability uptime model.
ability_trigger_leads.pvp_implication: Check activity legality and availability of free Grapple sources before modeling opening or sustained cooldowns.

ability_trigger_leads.official_summary: Fixed Withering Gaze on Cusp Sempiternal failing to weaken unless aiming when projectile made contact.
ability_trigger_leads.pve_implication: Projectile impact aiming state must not be treated as an ongoing mandatory activation gate; actual fire/swap trigger timing still requires testing.
ability_trigger_leads.pvp_implication: Do not infer Guardian damage or TTK from this combatant-oriented weakening fix.
